scope: Initial read-only production connectivity diagnosis, followed by an authorized configuration-only redeployment, a failed user LINE math test and a minimal Gemini adapter repair deployed successfully. No model inference calls or messages were sent by the inspector. The code-repair release version and readiness are verified; a new user LINE reply remains unverified.

recentWebhookEvidence.limitation: Proxy and handler timings are separate observations, not full customer latency or AI model measurements. No message bodies were read.

userVerification.source: User report relayed by coordinating agent
userVerification.healthCommand: Before configuration repair, user supplied actual LINE health response: Gemini disabled or not configured; fallback paused - authentication rejected.

postRepairModelTest.actualReply: I could not verify that request. If you were proposing an action or note, type pending to check whether a proposal was saved before retrying.
postRepairModelTest.cause: Gemini HTTP 400 observed in the live request log. A request-format/schema mismatch is under investigation but is not yet causally confirmed.

postRepairFailureEvidence.investigationHypothesis: Request-format/schema mismatch; not yet causally confirmed
postRepairFailureEvidence.limitation: Request and webhook durations measure different scopes. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.

postCodeRepairSuccessEvidence.deliveryEvidence: Each associated webhook finished with status completed. In the deployed runtime, that status follows accepted LINE delivery and persistence of outgoing evidence.
postCodeRepairSuccessEvidence.privacy: No incoming or outgoing message bodies were read for this observation.
postCodeRepairSuccessEvidence.proves: The deployed LINE to Railway to Gemini to LINE path can complete successfully after the code repair.
postCodeRepairSuccessEvidence.doesNotProve: Answer correctness, useful tool execution, task completion, five-agent coordination or reliability under repeated load.

codeRepair.testStatus: Six post-deployment Gemini runs returned usable HTTP 200 responses and their webhook handlers completed. Message bodies were not read, so answer correctness remains unverified.
codeRepair.causalLimitation: The earlier request failed with HTTP 400 and the repaired deployment later completed the same provider path successfully. The logs do not isolate which individual contract change resolved the request.
